strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Wil Wiph reaches the southern edge
At this rate...!
Lord Drake, the rebels are all but routed... There's no problem.
Once we cross the Karakara Mountains... Castle Tartara, eh?
There's still a pesky fly buzzing about... What shall we do?
Leave it. A single Bochun can't accomplish anything.
Unless they come in numbers, this Wil Wiph won't fall.
I'm the only one left...
But I have to slow down the Wil Wiph, even a little!
But Lord Drake, however powerful the Wil Wiph may be,
as I said, it's not yet complete. Attacking the castle is premature.
...We can't afford to wait.
With the Holy Warrior gone, now is our perfect chance.
But Todd's unit, a key part of our forces, has gone missing.
Yes... Something is happening.
We must secure our footing in case of the unexpected.
...Even if it means rushing a little.
So a mere Bochun isn't even worth his attention. ...Drake!
(Where on earth did you go... Show?)
What!?
...Ugh, so bright... That light...
Dammit, what the hell just happened!?
Ugh... I've never seen this scenery before...
Huh? Where are we!?
(Hm!? This scenery... I know this place...?)
Where's the Gandor?
Hey, Show! Could this be...?
Yeah, no doubt about it. This is Byston Well!
The world said to lie between the sea and the land...
The homeland of souls... Byston Well...
What? What has happened?
(That's a Gundam... Which means...)
Look, Show! It's a Bochun!
The Dunbine! Show! Is that you, Show!?
Marvel! Is that you, Marvel!?
Show... I'm so glad you're safe...
Marvel... Sorry to worry you. I've come back from the surface world.
The surface world?
That's right~. Even I went to the surface world.
Those machines behind you are Federation units, aren't they?
Yeah, they're comrades I met on the surface.
Sorry to interrupt the big reunion,
but this doesn't look like the time for a long chat, does it?
Seems that way. No idea where we are... but it doesn't look good.
Right. ...Show, we have to stop the Wil Wiph!
Tell me the situation, Marvel. What is he... What is Drake planning!?
Drake intends to cross the Karakara!
He's going to attack Castle Tartara!?
We have to slow him down somehow...
What's going on?
Drake is about to invade Castle Tartara, our base.
Drake... You mean that army that showed up in New York and places?
Yes. I'll explain later!
For now, please stop that aura ship's advance!
If they get past there, we'll have let them invade Tartara.
Don't worry, everyone's really strong!
With that aura barrier, it'll be tough for our mobile suits...
Amuro! And here I was praising you!
Then leave it to me. I'll take them on with my Nobel Gundam!
We won't stop it unless we surround the battleship!
I don't really get it, but we just gotta aim for that big one, right?
If we shoot it down, there's no need to worry about an invasion...
Though that logic's a bit too simple.
I never imagined a summoning would take place!
Forces from the surface, it seems. What shall we do, Lord Drake?
...We hold our course.
Aside from minimal return fire, the Wil Wiph keeps advancing.
Send out the Aura Battler squad to intercept.
Lord Drake... I shall go out.
Hm? You yourself?
...Yes. They'd make ideal opponents to test the Spriggan's condition.
Very well. ...I'm counting on you, Shot.
Sir.
Here they come in droves!
This aura... Shot Weapon!
Looks like they scrambled out because our numbers grew. ...Captain!
Yes, I know. I'd rather not get dragged into a fight like this...
but it can't be helped. We stop that giant battleship!
...Hehehe... A mass summoning from the surface...
I don't know what's happening, but it's quite intriguing. ...Here I come...!
Ngh, to think the Wil Wiph would take this much damage...
If only the surface machines hadn't appeared...
Grr, we withdraw.
So close~. We really had 'em cornered, too.
Hey, is it okay to let them get away?
Yeah, really.
Driving them off is good enough.
Right, we shouldn't pursue too far. The situation's far too unclear...
It's frustrating... but I guess it can't be helped.
Doesn't make it any more fun, though.
Remaining enemy forces?
...Should we take down the ones still left?
We can't have the enemy knowing everything we do from here on.
Yeah, looks like that's all we can do.
...Nothing on radar...
Looks like we've wiped out Drake's forces.
Thanks to you all coming, we were saved. Thank you.
Not like we came here because we wanted to, though.
Getting zapped straight into a battlefield? Gimme a break.
Right. Feels like we never get a break.
What...do we do now, Captain?
We ended up in battle without knowing what's going on...
Anyway, why don't we sort out what we know somewhere safe?
Right... Miss Frozen, could you guide us somewhere suitable?
Understood. Please follow me.
